corrections.issue: Wrong speaker: the host (Alan) only states the maxim ('in the short term, markets are voting machine, in the long term a weighing machine') and that these things bend market reality eventually; the instruction to start from the market as voting machine, model flows first, and not draw a linear line from news to markets, and that markets are the biggest driver of liquidity, is Jim's reply ('that eventually can happen in five years, Alan').
corrections.fix: Jim (replying to Alan): do not draw a linear line from news to markets; start with the market as voting machine, put in the flow ingredients to model what happens in the short term, and then see how that affects long-term macro outcomes, because markets are the biggest driver of liquidity and the eventual weighing-machine effect can take five years. Alan only states the voting machine / weighing machine contrast.
